word.name: concept header for the concept of nostr event taggings
word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Nostr Event Taggings

conceptHeader.description: A nostr-event-tag is an event that applies a specific Tag to a specific event (referenced by the e or a tag). The descriptor (which Tag) is referenced indirectly via a z-tag pointing at the Tag's per-tag tagging header, leaving e/a free for the target. Optional polarity is expressed as an event-tag (1 = applied, -1 = disputed; absent = applied). Publishing is permissionless; whether a tagging counts is computed per point-of-view at read time.
